problem: A deck contains $10$ cards labeled with the numbers $21$, $22$, $23,…,30.$ If one card is randomly drawn from the deck, what is its expected value?

activity_context.topic_title: Expected Values of Discrete Random Variables

feedback.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the roll of a four-sided die. Then the support is $S={1,5,7,8},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{4}:$

$$
f(1)=f(5)=f(7)=f(8)=\frac{1}{4}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+5\cdot f(5)+7\cdot f(7)+8\cdot f(8) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{4})+5(\frac{1}{4})+7(\frac{1}{4})+8(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{4}+\frac{5}{4}+\frac{7}{4}+\frac{8}{4} \\  & =\frac{1+5+7+8}{4} \\  & =\frac{21}{4} \\  & =5.25.\end{aligned}
$$
